jobs.prompt: Create one premium educational anatomical fitness illustration for WALL SIT (NARROW STANCE), canonical exercise7557, ADULT MALE. Reference is artistic style ONLY, not squat pose. ONE static HOLD pose, no sequence. Pure white background, a plain pale-gray vertical wall behind exerciser, soft shadows, crisp detailed grayscale anatomy and realistic proportions. Near side three-quarter view clearly showing back and hips touching wall and both feet. Back supported firmly against wall, thighs near horizontal, hips and knees about90 degrees, knees directly above ankles, shins vertical. Feet CLOSE TOGETHER, a narrow stance with only small gap between shoes and knees tracking forward above ankles. Both whole soles flat on floor. Arms relaxed at sides, hands not pressing on thighs. No dumbbell or other equipment and no chair. Wear real black opaque sleeveless training top fully covering torso/back/sides, knee-length black shorts with full rear seat crotch side/front coverage, closed leg openings, normal seams and folds, black shoes. Red teaching overlay over quadriceps region ON INTACT SHORTS, preserving fabric and folds; no cutaway or see-through anatomy. No red elsewhere. Keep head neck in comfortable neutral alignment and full figure well within frame with white margins. Detailed anatomical contours only on exposed areas, equal quality to approved reference, no flesh-colored photographic skin. No words, captions, numbers, labels, arrows, logos. This is a static hold, not a video.
